ghsa_scope_choice.instructor_discretion_evidence: User-supplied Prof Riehle reply displayed 2026-11-02 12:35 PM

primary_policy.selection: Highest stable semantic version among eligible supplied July2025-June2026 records before outcome-based exclusions
primary_policy.basis: The Worklog describes the supplied prediction input immediately before defining latest as highest semantic version; applying latest to that input is the strongest contextual reading
primary_policy.forecast_origin: Publication timestamp of that highest supplied stable version
primary_policy.calendar: Fixed M0=June2026 through M11=July2025 with origin-known observations
primary_policy.later_manifests: Exclude versions published after the selected origin from release-time input; preserve them in original data
primary_policy.dataset_scope: Reference cohort in data/corrected; the expanded primary export is datasets/training/data/corrected.

executed_verification.scope: Reference cohort source and replay counts; current repository test suite.

supplemental_manifest_recovery.reason: Publication timestamps exist in the original frozen npm captures but version manifests are missing
supplemental_manifest_recovery.capture_verification: All three compressed-file and decompressed HTTP-response SHA-256 values matched the recorded inventory; direct npm lookups recorded HTTP 404 and public mirror captures recorded HTTP 200
supplemental_manifest_recovery.source_role: Public npm mirror supplies missing manifests; original npm captures alone supply publication timestamps
supplemental_manifest_recovery.limitation: Retained mirror metadata is authentic to its recorded source response, not proof of immutable original npm metadata at release

calendar_semantics.explicit_month_identity: M0 is June 2026; M11 is July 2025
calendar_semantics.overlap_finding: All 39 represented reference-cohort packages have an origin before the end of June 2026.
calendar_semantics.source_basis: Workbook H18 permits observed daily download sums, H21 records coverage, and H56/H62 define GHSA state at prediction.
calendar_semantics.conditional_incompatibility: Complete eventual July2025-June2026 aggregates cannot all be known at an earlier release origin. Origin-known partial observations in those same calendar buckets can coexist with that origin.
calendar_semantics.ghsa_monthly_meaning: Distinct qualifying origin-snapshot IDs published before the origin, partitioned by fixed publication calendar month, with severity at prediction
calendar_semantics.future_ghsa_bucket_zero_meaning: No qualifying pre-origin IDs in that future calendar bucket; not zero eventual advisories. Verified snapshot evidence is required before claiming measured values.
calendar_semantics.missing_ghsa_snapshot_behavior: Unknown required measurements remain NULL; no verified zero inferred from unavailable or invalid evidence
calendar_semantics.download_policy: Sum only valid observed UTC days whose end is at or before origin, with observed-day count; no full intraday release-day observation or extrapolation
calendar_semantics.stable_release_policy: Count valid timestamped stable publications at or before origin within fixed calendar buckets, including anchor release; not eventual full-month totals
calendar_semantics.temporal_availability_rule: Four later express/undici manifests are excluded from the primary release-time input; both yargs supplied manifests are additionally excluded only in the all-precutoff sensitivity view. Original records remain accessible.

output_interfaces.resolution: Retain all five training targets and expose the four requested prediction outputs separately; do not redistribute unknown

interpretive_notes: Supplied versions are the explicitly selected primary universe based on immediate Worklog context; all-precutoff is retained as sensitivity analysis
Features use origin-known fixed-calendar observations, explicit download coverage and exclusion of later manifests
Complete eventual calendar aggregates after an earlier release would leak; the source does not require complete eventual monthly observation
limits: Maximum selection over the supplied full window is retrospective cohort selection, not knowledge available prospectively at the release instant
Retrospective npm captures do not prove unchanged origin-time registry contents or coverage of unpublished versions
Git snapshots establish preserved mirror state, not exact historical GitHub service synchronization

Publication-date revision guard excludes IDs already in the origin reviewed corpus; prior unreviewed, malware or deleted presence is not reconstructed and globally first-ever publication is not proven
Half-open [origin, origin+90d) endpoint convention is an implementation choice
